description: This file is the entry point for starting an HTTP server using an Express app. It sets up server listening on environment-defined or default port and host, and handles graceful shutdown on SIGTERM signal.

methods.name: app.listen
methods.description: Starts the server listening on specified port and host.

methods.name: process.on
methods.description: Registers an event handler for process signals, here for SIGTERM.

methods.name: process.exit
methods.description: Exits the process after server shutdown.
